title: I am a ruin aborigine
summary: The open space outside the parking area fuses into the mainroad, with no clear boundary other than a vest-sized road sign. I did not see the parking area itself, which is roughly beyond a crossbar at a corner. However, should any major event occur, the open space would doubtlessly be filled with cars at all.
